title: 2001 AMC 10 Problem 9
statement: The state income tax where Kristin lives is levied at the rate of \(p\%\) of the first \(\$28000\) of annual income plus \((p+2)\%\) of any amount above \(\$28000.\) Kristin noticed that the state income tax she paid amounted to \((p+0.25)\%\) of her annual income. What was her annual income?

solutions.text:
Let her income be \(x\ge28000.\) Then

\[ \begin{aligned} &\tfrac{p}{100}(28000) \\ &\quad {}+\tfrac{p+2}{100}(x-28000) \\ &\quad =\tfrac{p+0.25}{100}x. \end{aligned} \]

Multiplying by \(100\) and expanding, all the \(p\) terms cancel, leaving \(2x-56000=0.25x.\) So \(1.75x=56000\) and \(x=32000.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Let her income be \(x\gt28000\) and write the tax two different ways
